forum.title: Potential Error in the STEVAL-CAM-M0I Data Brief
forum.best_answer_content:
Hi ​@wqTZ ,

Thank you for pointing this out. You are correct, the connector reference is incorrect in the data brief. This is a 22pin connector, so the good reference is FH12-22S-0.5SH(55).

Best regards,

Jean
forum.content_text:
![](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/2abd3fec-e199-455e-8d37-17778c5668c0.png)

The Data Brief for the STEVAL-CAM-M0I adapter board references the FH12-24S-0.5SH(55), which is a 24-pin connector. However, the cable pinout appears to be the usual 22 pins. Is this a mistake in the Data Brief, or is there something I'm overlooking?

[Data brief - STEVAL-CAM-M0I - P-Board: Hardware MIPI CSI-2 kit for the evaluation and integration of promodules on embedded processing platforms](https://www.st.com/resource/en/data_brief/steval-cam-m0i.pdf)
forum.author: wqTZ

scraped_replies.html:
Hi ​@wqTZ ,

Thank you for pointing this out. You are correct, the connector reference is incorrect in the data brief. This is a 22pin connector, so the good reference is FH12-22S-0.5SH(55).

 

Best regards,

Jean
scraped_replies.author: Jean_Poire
